metricDefinitions.label: Non-pumped reservoir capacity
metricDefinitions.definition: Net reservoir-class hydro capacity after removing the pumped-hydro subset reported within the same Terna reservoir perimeter.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Subtract pumped-hydro NET MW from reservoir-including-pumping NET MW at the same geographic grain.
metricDefinitions.formula: Reservoir including pumping NET MW − pumped-hydro NET MW

caveats: Terna's northern macro-region maps wholly to MEM NORD; the remaining macro-regions do not provide a clean one-to-one mapping to all six other MEM zones.
Only source-compatible spatial allocations were promoted to MODEL_READY.

evidenceFlow.title: Direct control to solver-compatible parameter
evidenceFlow.detail: Terna NET controls are retained directly; only the NORD run-of-river, basin and non-pumped reservoir classes have a defensible zone/type intersection.

source.label: Terna 2025 Development Plan, Terna storage study and MEM candidate allocations

metricDefinitions.label: Operational PHS storage energy
metricDefinitions.definition: Terna's system-operational electrical storage quantity for the relevant existing pumping fleet, distinct from reconstructed full physical reservoir potential energy.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Retain the national Terna control without imposing an unapproved zonal allocation.

metricDefinitions.label: Round-trip efficiency
metricDefinitions.definition: Net electrical output divided by electrical input over a complete pumping and generating cycle, including relevant auxiliaries.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Terna technology-level range retained as a model candidate; no plant-specific efficiency was inferred.

caveats: All three zonal energy methods are project assumptions or sensitivities, not direct plant-level Terna evidence.
The open HPHS 626.262 GWh is physical reservoir-energy evidence only and is not normalized into a canonical e_nom.

evidenceFlow.title: National control retained
evidenceFlow.detail: The national 53 GWh and 6.4 GW controls remain canonical at national grain; zonal model inputs stay blank pending approval.

queries.reportingPeriod: Terna planning context 2025; historical fleet reference 2024

methods.code:
Method A: allocate 53 GWh by Terna zonal pumped-discharge-power shares.
Method B: normalize open HPHS physical-energy shares as a sensitivity only.
Method C: allocate 75% to the four principal candidate pure-PHS plants, then allocate the remainder by Terna zonal discharge shares.

metricDefinitions.label: Tracker available
metricDefinitions.definition: A complete official release workbook is present locally and can be archived before filtering.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Search the approved MEM workspace and previously used project locations once for the required releases.

caveats: Archived source-page metadata is not the complete tracker workbook.
No 2026 stack, change register or 2040 physical bridge was fabricated in the absence of the releases.

evidenceFlow.title: External acquisition gate
evidenceFlow.detail: Both official tracker workbooks are required to resolve gas/oil and coal plant identity, fuel, status and 2024–2026 changes while Terna remains the NET-MW control.

methods.code: Absent tracker workbooks block current-fleet and future-fleet attribution only; they do not reopen the frozen 2019–2024 historical technology measurements.
